Why did you walk out on me? Why am I pacing the floor, wringing my hands over these outrageous people?
give me a map, So I can find my way to the sacred mountain, to the place of your presence,
meet my exuberant God, Sing my thanks with a harp, magnificent God, my God.
Why are you crying the blues? Fix my eyes on God— soon I'll be praising again. He puts a smile on my face. He's my God.
